recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, high-angle close-up of a male subject looking downward with hands clutching his head, framed by prominent iced-out watches and heavy gold chains. The composition is defined by a desaturated, gritty skin tone contrasted against brilliant, glowing highlights from jewelry and horizontal anamorphic lens flares.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetrical framing created by the subject's forearms and watches.
Contrast between the matte, textured skin and the reflective, sparkling jewelry.
Vertical hierarchy from the subject's face down to the layered pendants.
Horizontal lens flares cutting across the lower third to anchor the typography.
coreInvariants: High-angle perspective looking down at the subject.
Prominent display of luxury watches on both wrists.
Cool-toned shadows with warm, glowing highlights on metal.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject's head is centered in the upper half; forearms create a V-shape framing the face.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, diamond-encrusted pendant in the center chest area.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's eyes, moves down the arms to the watches, and settles on the central jewelry and text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is tightly packed with the subject and accessories.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated skin tones and cool grays in the shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white highlights from diamond reflections.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm gold and yellow from jewelry and lens flares.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the subject's skin; high value contrast between dark shadows and blown-out highlights.

letterConstructionRules: Wide tracking for the main title

composition.relationshipToImage: Separated by a thin horizontal rule

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for the title paired with a clean, wide-tracked secondary line separated by a geometric rule.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the sharp serif and classical yet modern feel.
Provides the high stroke contrast seen in the display text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-angle, close-up photo of a man looking down with hands on his head. He wears two large diamond-encrusted watches and several thick gold chains with large pendants. The lighting is dramatic with cool shadows and bright, sparkling highlights on the jewelry. Add horizontal golden lens flares across the chest area.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add right-aligned text in the bottom right corner using a light-weight, high-contrast serif font. Use all caps. Place a thin horizontal line between the artist name and the title. Ensure the text is white with a very subtle drop shadow for readability against the background.

verificationChecks: Is the perspective high-angle looking down?
Are there two distinct watches visible?
Are the lens flares horizontal and anamorphic?

postGenerationChecks: Confirm jewelry has a 'sparkling' or 'iced out' effect.
Ensure the subject's expression is somber or intense.
Check that the horizontal rule is perfectly level.
Verify the color palette remains desaturated except for the gold/flare accents.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine high-angle urban portraiture with luxury accessory focus and right-aligned, high-contrast serif typography separated by geometric rules.
